headword: {印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}

definitions.gloss: certificate of seal registration, seal certificate
definitions.explanation: An official document issued by a municipal office that certifies a registered personal seal ({実印|じついん}). Required for major legal and financial transactions in Japan.

examples.japanese: {印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To obtain a seal registration certificate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A seal registration certificate is required for real estate contracts.

examples.japanese: {印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有効期限|ゆうこうきげん}→有効期限：06415_yuukoukigen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Seal registration certificates are often valid for three months from the date of issue.

notes:
COMPONENTS: ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ (seal/stamp) + ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧ (certification/proof). Full formal name: {印鑑登録証明書|いんかんとうろくしょうめいしょ}.

Needed for major transactions:
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{売買|ばいばい}→売買：04336_baibai⟧ — real estate purchase
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧ — car purchase
- ⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧ — inheritance
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧ — company establishment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧ — registered personal seal
- ⟦{印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}→印鑑登録：07491_inkantouroku⟧ — seal registration (the act of registering)
- ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧ — unofficial seal (for everyday use)
